description: We are MEDICJAB, a team of electronic engineering students from Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos (UNMSM) in Peru. We are passionate about technology, innovation, and building smart software solutions. Our combined skills cover programming, embedded systems, and system design.
summary: MEDICJAB is an autonomous, 100% offline-first astronaut health monitoring and medical decision-support system engineered for deep-space exploration missions where real-time Earth communication is disrupted by severe transmission latency (up to 20+ minutes one-way) or complete signal blackouts. Built around NASA's 5 S.H.A.R.E. spaceflight hazards (Space Radiation, Isolation & Confinement, Distance from Earth, Gravity Fields, and Hostile Environments), MEDICJAB fuses real-time Digital Signal Processing (DSP), onboard Edge AI (INT8 quantized 1D-CNN), an autonomous Bio-Digital Twin clinical engine, and a blackout-resilient local telemetry gateway.   Operating entirely on local hardware without cloud or external API dependencies, MEDICJAB continuously processes multi-modal physiological vitals (ECG, SpO2, Blood Pressure, Glucose, Core Temperature) alongside cabin environmental metrics (CO2, cabin pressure, radiation, VOCs). The system automatically enforces clinical decision algorithms derived from NASA-STD-3001, executes automated psychological screenings (PHQ-9 / GAD-7), and triggers shared-decision countermeasure protocols (AHRQ S.H.A.R.E.) to ensure crew health and mission survival without requiring ground control intervention.
details:
Overview & Deep-Space Context

Deep-space missions beyond LEO face severe communication delays (up to 20+ minutes) and total orbital blackouts, preventing flight surgeons from providing real-time triage. MEDICJAB solves this autonomy gap by functioning as an intelligent, 100% offline biomedical triage assistant and clinical decision system built around NASA's 5 S.H.A.R.E. spaceflight hazards.

How It Works

- Biomedical Signal Processing (DSP): Ingests raw single-lead ECG telemetry, applying a 60 Hz notch filter, a 0.5–40 Hz Butterworth bandpass filter, and Pan-Tompkins QRS detection to compute real-time BPM and HRV metrics (SDNN/RMSSD).

- Edge AI Arrhythmia Triage: Evaluates 216-sample R-peak windows using an onboard INT8 quantized 1D-CNN in TensorFlow Lite for instant cardiac waveform classification with zero cloud latency.

- Bio-Digital Twin Clinical Engine: Evaluates continuous vitals against NASA-STD-3001 normative rules, triggering actionable non-pharmacological countermeasures via the AHRQ S.H.A.R.E. decision framework.

- Behavioral Health & Gateway: Executes automated PHQ-9 and GAD-7 screenings with instant safety override protocols, caching all data in a dual SQLite and FIFO buffer gateway to guarantee zero packet loss during blackouts.

Benefits & Intended Impact

MEDICJAB delivers complete medical autonomy for deep-space crews. It eliminates ground dependency, combines physiological and psychological health monitoring into one interface, and protects telemetry data during signal blackouts, ensuring crew survival on Artemis lunar and Martian missions.

Development Tools & Technology Stack

- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6 Modules), Canvas API (120 Hz ECG rendering), SVG 3D Body Scanner.

- Backend & Processing: Python 3.11, FastAPI (WebSocket broadcast), NumPy, SciPy (scipy.signal), Pandas.

- Machine Learning & Storage: TensorFlow Lite (INT8 1D-CNN), PyYAML clinical rules parser, SQLite3 with FIFO Queue Pipeline architecture.

Creativity, Innovation & Design Considerations

- 100% Offline-First Architecture: Zero external API calls, running entirely on local mission hardware.

- Standards Alignment: Directly integrated with NASA-STD-3001 clinical limits (SpO2 < 88%, ppCO2 >= 7.6 mmHg, noise NC-40/50, CNS radiation 500 mGy/30d).

- Adaptive Gravity Engine: Calibrated for acute orthostatic intolerance and fluid shifts across 0g microgravity, 0.16g Lunar, and 0.38g Martian gravity.
